scope: Checkpoint input bursts only; read-only artifact analysis. No app workload or harness edits.
cpuMethod: 100 Hz proc task utime+stime deltas summed across same retained task IDs. Percent uses one core=100%; two-core capacity=200%. Helper children are reaped-child cutime+cstime and exclude still-running child work until reaped. xinput shown separately; do not add it again to helper child totals. Intervals use samples entirely inside phase; input phase is short and coarse. No verified Flutter main-thread identity.

burst.observer_scope: XI2 root observer, no focus change/exclusive grab. Received-line timestamps include client scheduling/buffering; raw X event time remains in lines. No app consumption acknowledgement.
burst.sampling_note: Identical 10Hz target frame/task sampling in both modes/counts, with one second idle before input and eight seconds observation after. No OCR or SCP during burst.

manualPixelInspection.scope: Inspected first caret-aware full candidate for every repetition, and every retained post-exit frame before that candidate. Existing field crops are derived from retained raw frames; used an enlarged contact sheet solely for offline inspection.
manualPixelInspection.findings: All 12 first-full candidates visibly contain Probe2414.txt with caret. 5000 typing0 frames14/15 visibly Pr; typing1 frames14/15 and typing2 frame15 visibly Probe2414. with caret (OCR misses final dot). 5000 paste post-exit pre-full frames show selected original name. No matching or harness behavior changed.

limitations: No receiver application event-consumption acknowledgement or render/presentation timestamp. Screenshot timestamps bracket capture, not actual first paint.
X server event milliseconds and observer receipt monotonic clocks have observed near offsets, but no formal synchronization; raw event spans are safer than absolute latency claims.
All-task delta totals include only IDs retained at both phase endpoints and can omit CPU of short-lived tasks. Reads are sequential, 100Hz ticks, phase windows short.

Helper child CPU is cumulative reaped-child accounting; differs temporally from instantaneous child CPU and excludes current still-running child. Helper/xinput RSS omits transient screenshot children and X server memory.
Same instrumentation does not remove observer effects; there is no observer-off control. Idle means no injected input while capture and cursor rendering remain active.
Thread comm names, including io.flutter.ui and llvmpipe, are observed names, not independently verified main-thread or application acknowledgement identity.
Checkpoint does not establish full-save completion; cloud save run continues separately.
